MaxExecutionSteps Specifies the maximum number of execution steps allowed during the evaluation of a game event script. This limit is used to control the computational workload of scripts and to prevent scripts from consuming excessive runtime resources or entering infinite execution loops. public int MaxExecutionSteps { get; init; } Property Value int Remarks The value of this property defines an upper bound on the number of discrete steps a script is permitted to execute before being halted. A step typically corresponds to a fundamental operation or instruction within the script's runtime environment. MaxGeneratedCollectionItems Specifies the maximum size of each collection incrementally materialized by generated lists and iterator-backed selectors. public int MaxGeneratedCollectionItems { get; init; } Property Value int Remarks The default is 10,000; a nonpositive value disables this limit. Separate collections have separate size limits; this property does not bound existing inputs or allocated bytes. MaxLoopIterations Specifies the maximum number of successful iterator advances across loops and iterator-backed selectors in one handler. public int MaxLoopIterations { get; init; } Property Value int Remarks The default is 100,000; a nonpositive value disables this limit.
